_comment: Perk adapter: Paths of Empyrean 1.0 (Nexus 58656). Its perks ask for vanilla keywords (vanilla.json),
Lost Grimoire's damage keywords (Lost Grimoire is a hard master of PathsOfEmpyrean.esp, so they always
exist with it) and its own summon keyword. They also ask MAG_MagicDamagePoison and MAG_MagicDamageSun
(PoE carries copies of those Update.esm records), but every condition that asks one of the two asks the
GRIM_K twin in the same OR group, and Fear The Dawn asks GRIM_K_MagicDamageSun alone - so the GRIM_K
keywords cover every perk and the MAG_ ones add nothing. adamant.json stays off under PoE: it would
also give MAG_ shield, circle, wall and influence keywords no PoE perk reads.
Conditions as in vanilla.json; the lines reuse the shapes of adamant.json (poison, sun) and
pathofsorcery.json (disease, daedra summons). Keywords are named by FormID (keywordForm).
MAG_MagicDamagePoison, MAG_MagicDamageSun - always ORed with the GRIM_K twin (above)
PoE_K_MagicTransformation (Metamorphosis) - the librarian gives Lost Grimoire's polymorphs no tag
that sets them apart ('transform' is bound weapons and alteration of the self); no scan field either
GRIM_K_RES_Cocoon, GRIM_K_CON_FamiliarBoosted - Lost Grimoire's own spell mechanics
PoE_K_DruidScaleDur, PoE_K_MagicDestructionNoScale - PoE's own markers (the second is an exclusion)
PoE_K_MagicShoutScale*, MagicShout, ISP_K_*, PoE_K_Weap* - shouts, songs, weapon and potion effects
DLC2MagicAshSpawn - one Dragonborn effect the perk names directly

adapters.why: poison damage (Druid, Spell Aegis, Aetherial Shield and the damage scaling OR lists)
sun and holy damage (Fear The Dawn asks this one alone; the OR lists ask it beside MAG_MagicDamageSun)
disease damage (Druid, the damage OR lists). Lost Grimoire's Horrid Affliction is a scripted effect, so no actor value is asked
kinetic damage: unresisted force damage to health (Telekinetic asks this one alone). Lost Grimoire's own carriers - Force Wave, Concussive Blast, Earthquake, Blasting Rune - are all this shape

by race: the summoned actor's race is daedra, and no other summon category (Legion of Souls, Summoner, Twin Souls). PoE itself puts it on Dremora, Seeker, Ash Guardian and Lost Grimoire's daedra, and takes MagicSummonShock off the Dremora
summoned daedra by tag, for an actor with no race keywords; fire, frost and storm atronachs pass PoE's summon perks through MagicSummonFire/Frost/Shock instead
